bounded_scope.reason: Project-Frankenstein full commit-DAG and frozen-head tree denominators remain unresolved; this is a bounded semantic lineage shard.

verified_mechanism_lineage.finding: PROJECT.md was introduced as persistent project base-of-truth, injected on every project chat and auto-updatable from model output.
verified_mechanism_lineage.current_implication: Preserve human-readable recovery/project packets as a secondary continuity/recovery surface, but do not let model-authored text bypass canonical provenance/CAS governance.

verified_mechanism_lineage.finding: Tool-use agent loop began project-directory sandboxed with path resolution checks, dangerous-command blocklist, exact edit failure semantics and bounded iterations.
verified_mechanism_lineage.current_implication: Fail-closed exact edits, bounded loops and explicit tool results remain reusable Harness/Needle primitives.

verified_mechanism_lineage.finding: A subsequent commit deliberately removed the project sandbox and granted broad filesystem/system tool access while retaining only a minimal destructive-command blocklist.
verified_mechanism_lineage.current_implication: Do not inherit this authority model. Treat it as evidence of architecture drift toward unsafe ambient authority; keep model output != execution authority and route capabilities through Needle/capability broker with scoped grants, provenance and rollback.

verified_mechanism_lineage.finding: Context compaction above an estimated ~40K tokens, task files, SSE streaming and a 25-iteration agent loop were implemented structurally; the commit explicitly states live API end-to-end validation was blocked by insufficient credits.
verified_mechanism_lineage.current_implication: Retain compaction as a candidate mechanism only; require replay-equivalence/information-loss tests before adoption.

verified_mechanism_lineage.finding: v3 implemented a world entity/relation graph, compact world snapshot, policy engine, activity feed, tiered deterministic/free-LLM/Claude action selection, bounded action chaining, outcome logging, profile updates, loop detection and minimal-context autonomous actions.
verified_mechanism_lineage.current_implication: Strong precursor for current Needle routing + event/replay Harness + ClayGraph/UnifiedDB separation: state plane, decision plane, authority plane and evidence plane should remain explicit.

verified_mechanism_lineage.finding: The v3 commit reports 39s/0-Claude-token autonomy cycle, 5-step/331s autonomous chain, 4s/0-Claude-token dream cycle, a real-project dealer-contact example, and projected ~$0.02/day cost.
verified_mechanism_lineage.current_implication: Preserve as historical benchmark hypotheses only; do not promote without raw traces, exact workload, provider accounting and reproduction.

verified_mechanism_lineage.finding: v3/v3.2 tool/action success classification often relies on textual error markers or tool-use presence; A/B strategy testing counts absence of [ERROR]/[TIMEOUT] as success and auto-applies a winner.
verified_mechanism_lineage.current_implication: Reject proxy-only success as promotion criterion. Harness experiments need task-grounded outcome predicates, counterfactual/negative checks, rollback and holdout/OOD validation.

verified_mechanism_lineage.finding: Natural-language policies can be parsed by an LLM and automatically inserted; auto-refinement can also add policies from repeated failures/tool stats.
verified_mechanism_lineage.current_implication: Policy learning may propose candidates but must not silently mutate execution authority. Separate learned recommendation from enforceable policy; require typed validation/provenance and approval rules.

verified_mechanism_lineage.finding: v3.2 added session replay/time-travel, agent-profile cloning and cross-project peer queries over world snapshots/memory.
verified_mechanism_lineage.current_implication: Replay and peer-query are directly reusable concepts for the Research Center/Hive, but profile/knowledge transfer needs provenance, contamination boundaries and selective transfer tests.

crossread.compatibility: Consistent with peer finding that historical/recovery artifacts must be retained as lineage/provenance nodes rather than blindly restored; sandbox precursors and later variants require feature-level reconciliation.

harness: task-grounded evaluators instead of no-error proxies
frank: persistent project state + world model lineage
do not restore ambient full-system authority
claygraph_unifieddb: world entity/relation graph as historical precursor; preserve provenance and exact/event state separately
claycode: typed transition/effect contracts should replace free-form model text as execution authority
research_center: peer-query/profile-transfer concepts require provenance and contamination controls

negative_results_and_guards: No exact Level-0 coverage credit from this bounded history shard.
No historical performance/cost number was independently reproduced.
Full-system tool access is not selected as a current architecture recommendation.
Context-compaction functionality was structurally implemented but historical commit reports no live end-to-end validation due insufficient API credits.
next_falsifiers: Replay-equivalence benchmark comparing full vs compacted context on long tool trajectories.
Capability-broker ablation: ambient authority vs typed scoped capabilities under adversarial tool prompts.
Outcome-evaluator benchmark: no-error proxy vs task-grounded oracle across partial/false-success cases.
Policy-learning test: proposal-only vs auto-enforced mutation with provenance/rollback and policy-conflict injection.
Selective profile-transfer benchmark measuring positive transfer, contamination and cross-project leakage.
